Pricing

One flat rate. Any hour, any day.

Standard price is a clean ₹800/hour. Add hours as you like — the total scales linearly. Need the turf for more than 1 day? Send us an enquiry.

Same rate day or night — no surge, no hidden fee. Pay only for the hours you book.
